newsitem.title: USA: Health Management says bankruptcy filing possible.
newsitem.headline: Health Management says bankruptcy filing possible.

text.p: Health Management Inc said Tuesday it is likely to seek Federal Bankruptcy protection if merger negotiations between it and Transworld Home HealthCare Inc are not successful, or if Transworld does not agree to further extend its forbearance agreement in short term intervals as it has in the past.
The forbearance agreement relating to the company's senior debt has been extended to March 31, 1997.

Health Management said that in light of financial restatements and its third quarter financial results, it and Transworld are renegotiating the deal. If the parties are successful at renegotiating the deal, Health Management said the consideration to be paid to stockholders is not likely to exceed $0.30 a share.
Health Management on Tuesday reported a third quarter net loss of $1.66 a share, including a charge.

Health Management said it and Transworld are also renegotiating with the plaintiffs in the consolidated stockholder class action to amend the partial settlement to reduce the consideration to be paid to plaintiffs.
The current stipulation provides for a cash settlement of $7.2 million.
